reason: The walking skeleton (#45) drops the DWM dark-title-bar call; RequestedThemeVariant="Dark" gives Avalonia windows a dark title bar instead. Recorded as exempt in that slice.
Not ported, by design (#48): the Downgrader's progress chatter goes to print(), whose stdout is None in the windowed exe, so it was never visible or logged. The port writes no such lines.

Dead code (inventory section 14): read_mo2_ini collects [customExecutables] xEdit/BSArch paths into ModManagerInfo.executables, and nothing reads them. Environment (#49) skips the section's lines instead; the mo2-instance scenario shows a gamePath inside it is ignored.

Replaced, not ported (#56): the Scanner panes are borderless windows owned by the main window (OwnedPaneDocker), and Win32 hides owned windows when their owner is minimised and re-shows them on restore, so CMChecker.on_minimize/on_restore has no counterpart. dotnet/eng/Test-ScannerPanes.ps1 checks the panes are hidden on minimise and back in place on restore.
